 Siteimprove Accessibility Plug-in – Ensure Digital Accessibility Where it Matters Most 
 Siteimprove now offers a powerful plug-in for Drupal, empowering contributors to identify, prioritize, and remediate web accessibility issues directly in the CMS page editor. Unlike accessibility overlays that claim to offer one-click compliance, but fail to address underlying issues, Siteimprove’s Accessibility Plugin provides a real solution—fixing issues at the source. 

 Reduce manual effort with Siteimprove’s automated fixes and clear remediation

steps (ADA and WCAG standard compliant), and give your content team real-time

guidance to improve accessibility before issues go live.

 How this differs from the established siteimprove module? 
 Siteimprove provides the classic Siteimprove CMS sidebar/overlay inside Drupal, surfacing multiple products (Accessibility, QA, SEO, Policies, etc.) and “Recheck” flows during editing.

 Siteimprove Accessibility is accessibility-only, using Siteimprove’s latest automated engine to highlight & remediate accessibility issues right where editors work.

 Can they run together? 
 Yes. They are complementary: keep siteimprove for the multi-product sidebar and use siteimprove_accessibility for in-editor accessibility remediation

 Core Functionality 
 The Siteimprove Accessibility module provides enterprise-grade accessibility scanning capabilities by integrating Siteimprove's Alfa engine with Drupal. Key features include:

 Automated Scanning 
 
 Scans content during preview mode (configurable) 
 Uses Siteimprove's Alfa rules engine (WCAG 2.1 AA compliant) 
 Supports both automatic and manual scan initiation 
 
 Compliance Monitoring 
 
 Tracks accessibility issues over time 
 Provides historical trend analysis 
 Visual dashboards for compliance tracking 
 
 Issue Management 
 
 Categorizes issues by WCAG guidelines 
 Tracks occurrences across content 
 Provides detailed remediation guidance 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After module has been installed you may configure with the following options:

 Settings form path: /admin/config/siteimprove_accessibility/settings

 Manual Scans 
 
 Toggle: enable_manual_scans 
 Default: Enabled 
 Effect: Shows/hides manual scan button 
 
 Preview Auto-Scan 
 
 Toggle: preview_auto_scan 
 Default: Enabled 
 Effect: Automatically scans during node preview
